title: Projection-formula map
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes. Use the completed coefficient sheaves $A_X,A_Y$ and the notation $D(T_{\Proet},A)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and the ringed-topos pullback, direct image and adjunction $L=Lf^*\dashv R=Rf_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with its specified coefficient identification $f^{-1}A_Y\cong A_X$. Tensor products below are the uncompleted derived sheaf tensor bifunctors of [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. Let $K\in D(X_{\Proet},A)$ and $P\in D(Y_{\Proet},A)$. Write $\varepsilon_K:LRK\to K$ and $\eta_M:M\to RLM$ for the counit and unit of this adjunction. Let
$$c_{F,G}:L(F\otimes_{A_Y}^LG)\xrightarrow{\sim}LF\otimes_{A_X}^LLG$$
be the canonical natural comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], specialized to these pro-etale ringed topoi. Put $M=RK\otimes_{A_Y}^LP$ and $N=K\otimes_{A_X}^LLP$, and define
$$\alpha_{f,K,P}:LM\xrightarrow{c_{RK,P}}LRK\otimes_{A_X}^LLP\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_K\otimes^L1_{LP}}N.$$
The projection-formula morphism is the explicit composite
$$\pi_{f,K,P}:RK\otimes_{A_Y}^LP=M\xrightarrow{\eta_M}RLM\xrightarrow{R(\alpha_{f,K,P})}RN=Rf_*(K\otimes_{A_X}^LLf^*P).$$
Equivalently, it is the adjunct of $\alpha_{f,K,P}$ under the displayed derived adjunction. The abbreviation $\otimes_A^L$ in the blueprint means $\otimes_{A_Y}^L$ on $Y$ and $\otimes_{A_X}^L$ on $X$; no completed tensor product or assertion that $\pi_{f,K,P}$ is invertible is part of this definition.

(*Source:* the morphism is Stacks Project, Cohomology on Sites, Equation
21.50.0.1 (Tag [0B56](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B56)), the map
$Rf_*E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{\mathcal D}}K\to Rf_*(E\otimes^L_{\mathcal
O_{\mathcal C}}Lf^*K)$ of Section 21.50 (Tag
[0943](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0943), Projection formula), which
is defined there as the adjoint of the canonical map $Lf^*(Rf_*E\otimes^L_{
\mathcal O_{\mathcal D}}K)= Lf^*Rf_*E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{\mathcal
C}}Lf^*K\to E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{\mathcal C}}Lf^*K$ coming from the map
$Lf^*Rf_*E\to E$. The blueprint's $\pi_{f,K,P}$ is this map for the ambient
pro-etale ringed topoi with $E=K$ and $K=P$, and its description as the
adjoint of the tensor product of the counit $Lf^*Rf_*K\to K$ with $Lf^*P$ is
Stacks' description. Difference of generality: Stacks states the map for a
morphism of ringed topoi with coefficients in the structure sheaves $\mathcal
O_{\mathcal C}$, $\mathcal O_{\mathcal D}$, with no completeness hypothesis
and no coefficient tower, whereas the blueprint forms it for the operations
of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] inside the adic coefficient datum of
[def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]; no statement about the map itself
differs.)

noncomputable def proEtaleProjectionFormulaMate
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (a : ProEtaleTensorModel Y R) (b : ProEtaleTensorModel X S)
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X S))
    (Q : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Y R))
lean.note: The already-landed general pro-etale mate is exactly this definition after specializing the ring sheaves to the completed adic coefficients and c to their canonical inverse-image comparison. Its body calls derivedProjectionFormulaMate with the normalized derived adjunction and canonical tensor comparison; that mate is adj.homEquiv of tensor(counit,id). No second projection-map definition is introduced.

blueprint_update.statement:
For $f:X\to Y$, $K\in D(X_{\Proet},A)$, and $P\in D(Y_{\Proet},A)$, define

$$
 \pi_{f,K,P}:(Rf_*K)\otimes_A^LP
 \longrightarrow Rf_*(K\otimes_A^LLf^*P)
$$

as the adjoint of the tensor product of the counit $Lf^*Rf_*K\to K$ with
$Lf^*P$, using the operations of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations].
